beats.narration_text: Namaste — this is Liam, in for Bear. There is a skill called deep-explainer that most fellows will skip past thinking it is just a longer version of ai-explainer. It is not. So I asked Claude to read the whole SKILL.md and tell me what makes it its own thing.

show.event: composer cold-opens; spark + 'Namaste, Liam' greeting settles
command types itself in: the deep-explainer question
send arms; runningText plays
RESULT lines land in sequence

props.command: what does the deep-explainer skill actually do differently from ai-explainer?
output: extends ai-explainer; adds an act structure
vox is evidence, not texture — no quota
two hard gates the parent chassis lacks

beats.narration_text: Watch the writer walk this back. Deep-explainer is not ai-explainer stretched to five minutes. It is act-structured, with two hard gates its parent chassis does not have.

show.event: first breath: writer types the misconception in serif
'just ai-explainer, made longer' turns terracotta (about to be deleted)
replacement types in: 'act-structured, with two extra gates'
final corrected sentence stands

beats.act: Act I — What the skill IS
beats.narration_text: Read the second line of the SKILL and it says the quiet part out loud. Deep-explainer extends ai-explainer, which extends explainer. Nothing below repeals a parent law. So the four bookends, the show-don't-tell law, the illustrate law — those all come in for free.

show.event: heading types on: 'It extends its parents.'
verbatim quote card slides in from the left
verdict pill lands: 'INHERITED · not owned'

props.heading: It extends its parents.
props.body: Bookends, brand, laws, illustrate law, show-don't-tell law — all inherited from ai-explainer and explainer. Deep-explainer only adds the genre's own contracts.
props.quote: This skill EXTENDS ai-explainer, which extends explainer. Nothing below repeals a parent law; this file only adds the genre's own contracts.

beats.act: Act II — What makes it deep
beats.narration_text: The first rule is a rule about restraint. The five-to-ten minute band is a natural landing zone for a multi-act concept — never a target to pad toward. Deep-explainer is not make it longer. It is: this idea needs several linked mechanisms, each with its own evidence.

show.event: heading: 'Multi-act, not padded.'
quote card slides in with the arc-lands line
verdict pill: 'PACING · duration is an OUTPUT'

props.heading: Multi-act, not padded.
props.body: The 5–10 min band is the natural landing zone for a MULTI-ACT concept — several mechanisms, each with its own evidence. Never a target to pad toward.
props.quote: If the arc lands at 4:40, ship 4:40.

beats.act: Act II — What makes it deep
beats.narration_text: The old skill had a vox quota — twenty to twenty-five percent of body beats had to be pantry stills. That quota is dead. The new law: a still earns its beat only when the still IS the evidence. Not atmosphere. Not decoration. And zero vox beats can be a correct outcome.

show.event: heading: 'The vox quota is dead.'
quote card lands with the zero-vox line
verdict pill: 'VOX LAW · 2026-09-02'

props.heading: The vox quota is dead.
props.body: A still earns its beat only when the still IS the evidence — the actual record. Not texture. Not atmosphere. The old 20–25% target is superseded.
props.quote: A film whose evidence is text, code, or data correctly has zero vox beats.
props.cite: deep-explainer SKILL.md · THE BEAT MIX (VOX LAW governs)

beats.act: Act III — The two hard gates
beats.narration_text: Gate D-one: the first compile is always a full-length watchable previz. Vox beats render as slates — beat id plus narration line. Manim and Remotion render for real. Audio is real. This is honest by design. At this length, the pantry is the bottleneck, and the previz is what a human reviews for pacing.

show.event: heading: 'Gate D1 — the slate previz.'
quote card lands: 'Never present a previz as a finished cut.'
verdict pill: 'FIRST DELIVERABLE'

props.heading: Gate D1 — the slate previz.
props.body: First compile is always a full-length watchable previz. Vox beats render as slates. Manim and Remotion render for real. Audio is real. The previz is what a human reviews for pacing.
props.quote: Never present a previz as a finished cut.

beats.act: Act III — The two hard gates
beats.narration_text: Gate D-two: the shopping list. Written AFTER audio lock, never before. A card written before the beat's real length is known can only ask for a clip of X. After lock, it asks for at least seven point two seconds of X. Then trimming — lossless — becomes the default. Stretching — lossy — never has to happen.

show.event: heading: 'Gate D2 — the shopping list.'
quote card lands: 'SHOPPING.md is written after audio lock (never before).'
verdict pill: 'TRIM > STRETCH'

props.heading: Gate D2 — the shopping list.
props.body: Written AFTER audio lock. A card written before the beat's real length is known can only ask for 'a clip of X.' After lock, it asks for '≥ 7.2s of X.' Trim (lossless) wins over stretch (lossy).
props.quote: SHOPPING.md is written after audio lock (never before).

beats.narration_text: So the split. Bookends inherited. Middle owned. Two gates on top. Reach for deep-explainer when the source is multi-act — several mechanisms, each needing its own evidence. Reach for ai-explainer when it is one insight.

heading types on: 'The deep-explainer split.'
three numbered verdict lines reveal on the spoken cue

artifactLines: Bookends INHERITED from ai-explainer — cold open, hesitant writer, verdict, YOUR TURN, outro.
Middle OWNED by this skill — multi-act body, VOX LAW, pantry, shopping list.
Gate D1 — first compile is a full-length watchable previz. Slates are honest.
Gate D2 — shopping list is written AFTER audio lock, so trim (lossless) beats stretch (lossy).
REACH FOR IT when the source is multi-act — several linked mechanisms, each with evidence.
REACH ELSEWHERE — ai-explainer for one insight; math-explainer for math; cli-explainer for a build.
